name: PostgreSQL
shortDescription: MoviePilot media library automation backed by PostgreSQL for the database and Redis for the cache.

alerts.message: On first visit the web UI asks you to create the admin account and API key. Open it right after deploying so nobody else claims the instance.

Searching and downloading require user authentication with a supported site in the UI and your own downloader; a media server is optional and adds library checks. MoviePilot only organizes files it can see under this stack's /media volume, so downloads must land there.
